features: HD710 Pro External HDD - HD710 Pro ruggedized USB 3.0 portable hard drive is waterproof, dustproof and meeting military-specification as shockproof for extreme mobile data protection.
CAPACITY - With up to 2TB capacity, HD710 Pro is your best companion in keeping content safe whether you go diving, hiking, biking, or simply take a quick stroll.
SHOCK RESISTANCE - Passes the stringent Military MIL-STD-810G 516.6 drop test, This USB 3.0 drive is capable of handling the toughest conditions & still delivers your data at the blazing-fast speeds.
IP68 WATER RESISTANT - Offering excellent water and dust protection. It works normally even in a dusty environment or after being submerged in 1.5 meter-deep water for up to 60 minutes.
USB CABLE - The USB cable tucks into a wrap-around exterior slot in the drive casing, providing an elegant storage solution that matches the highly practical characteristics of the device.
LED INDICATOR - Features a bright cold-blue LED indicator that shines through the enclosure to indicate power and data transfer status.
WARRANTY - 3 years warranty provided by the manufacturer from date of purchase.
